title: PVLLC AV Device Catalog
description: Machine-readable device catalog for an AV signal-flow diagram app. Nodes on a canvas have typed input/output ports used for patch sheets and wiring. Fields that are not confirmed from a cited source must be null or the string 'unknown' — never guessed. Port counts are omitted (count: null) when not confirmed.

schema_version.description: Catalog schema version. Device ids are stable across versions; fields may be added in later minor versions.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (America/Chicago local with offset) when this file was written.

confidence.description: high = read from a manufacturer datasheet, tech-specs page or manual cited in sources; medium = manufacturer marketing page or clearly labelled rear-panel photo with a cited URL, or two independent reputable sources agreeing; low = reputable third-party listing only; none = identity known, I/O not captured.

unknown_string.description: Use the literal 'unknown' or null when a value is not confirmed. Never invent a number or connector.

retrieved.description: Date the source was opened, YYYY-MM-DD, or null if taken from a previously dated local copy.

id.description: Stable port-group id within the device, e.g. 'sdi-in', 'hdmi-out-mv', 'ref-in'. Numbered groups when connectors differ.

name.description: Label as it should appear on a node / patch sheet, e.g. '12G-SDI In'.

count.description: Number of physical connectors in this group. Must be a positive integer from a cited source, or null if unknown. Never invent.

max_format.description: Highest advertised video/audio format, e.g. '2160p60 12-bit', 'HDMI 2.0 4K60', '32ch MADI 96 kHz'. 'unknown' or null if not stated.

convertible.description: True when the same physical connectors can be re-allocated (e.g. 4x 3G = 1x 12G, or SDI/HDMI combo). Default false.

optional.description: True when this group is an option card, license, or factory option — not present on every unit.

hot_pluggable_card.description: Slot or option-card name if modular, e.g. 'Input slot 1-8', 'Event Master 4K input card'.

control_protocols.description: Protocols this port speaks, if it is a control or hybrid port. Device-level protocols also live on the device.

redundant.description: true/false if known, null if unknown.

id.description: Stable lowercase dotted id, manufacturer_id first, then a kebab-case model slug. Example: 'blackmagic.atem-constellation-4me-4k'. Do not change once published; add a new id and list the old one in aliases if a rename is required.

model.description: Official model name as sold, e.g. 'ATEM Constellation 4 M/E 4K'.

sku.description: Manufacturer SKU / part number if known.

ports.description: Physical connector groups. Empty array with port_data_confidence 'none' when I/O has not been confirmed.

control_protocols.description: Device-level control protocols, e.g. 'ATEM', 'Videohub', 'HTTP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'OSC', 'Telnet', 'VISCA', 'Panasonic AW', 'RossTalk', 'Barco E2 JSON-RPC', 'AWJ', 'TSL UMD'.

companion_modules.description: Bitfocus Companion module ids from bitfocus.io/connections, e.g. 'bmd-atem'.

aliases.description: Other names, former names, or previous catalog ids.

variants.description: Closely related SKUs that share this node's ports (or are called out in notes), e.g. region codes.

modular.description: True when I/O depends on installed cards. Stock/factory configuration is listed in ports when known; option cards are optional:true.
